notes.title: Ancient Russian Life Simulator + Update + Incoming Sale
notes.notes:
[h3]Update[/h3]
We have released an update to prepare you for the release of the prequel to Russian Life Simulator - Ancient Russian Life Simulator, which will tell about the greatest exploits of the ancient Rus in the war against lizards, will allow you to use the most famous techniques of the ancient Rus and receive the blessing of the gods! And of course, MASSACRE THE GODLY LIZARDS!
The game's release is scheduled for December 15, 2023, but you can download the update for Russian Life Simulator now!
[h3]Sale[/h3]
We are also planning to launch a 50% discount for Russian Life Simulator on December 13th, so you can play the original part before the prequel releases!

notes.title: Halloween event!
notes.notes:
This year we have prepared a really big update for you with a Halloween event!
[h3]Main innovation:[/h3]
The main goal of the Halloween event will be to hunt ghosts - quilted jackets that inhabit all locations of the game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34987081/dfc57f3b439720f7a6e1ab85d2d17cd62460e321.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34987081/10792be70a62e524970385a3dd2fef41d4e09f05.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34987081/1745281d960132c7849718f20c56c1caf064ca84.png[/img]
[h3]Details:[/h3]
As befits a clicker, to catch them you need to click on them 10 times, after which the ghost will disappear and give you a terrifying gift or in-game currency. After capturing 10 ghosts, you will unlock that ghost as a [b]playable character[/b]!
[h3]Design:[/h3]
We have added Halloween decorations to all available locations in the game, it includes original Russian pumpkins and bats!
[h3]Date:[/h3]
The event will be held from October 24 20:00 to November 2 20:00
[h3]Warning:[/h3]
Beware of the ghost of the military commissar, he might have a [b]surprise[/b] for you!

notes.title: Global update!
notes.notes:
A global update for Russian Life Simulatora has already been released, a lot of new, interesting content has been added to the game. After reaching a pension of 20,000, a button will appear in the upper left corner, by clicking on which Vladimir Vladimirovich will turn to you for help.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34987081/5c1880e649a52df85faa1bc0104927d04e4db14a.png[/img]

The update contains:
[olist]
[*] Continuation of the plot story about the life of a Russian
[*] New locations
[*] New clothes
[*] New items in the store
[*] New sounds
[*] New game events
[*] Ability to start the game from the very beginning
[*] Halloween decoration of locations
[*] Various improvements and bug fixes
[/olist]

I also remind you that the game recently released collection cards, backgrounds, emoticons and badges, which you can get by simply playing!

notes.title: The long-awaited release of backgrounds, cards and emoticons!
notes.notes:
Finally, Steam gave permission for the release of cards, backgrounds and emoticons.
Unfortunately, they differ from those presented to you earlier, all because Steam does not allow memes of any kind to be used in cards, backgrounds and emoticons.
In this regard, cards, backgrounds and emoticons have been redone and now are Russians of all sorts and types. Together with them, the flags of Russia and Ukraine were added as backgrounds, and the metal badge that you can get by collecting all the metal cards shows the strongest and most reliable currency in the world - the Russian Ruble.
Cards:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34987081/f290ceae92b6d663c8660ad6fbe3518c21b73022.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34987081/2ea1d3d4850c3c71582bc0043b6512dcde320e5b.png[/img]
For those who spent more than an hour in the game, Steam already sent cards for conversion 1 hour in the game = 1 card, I suggest everyone else to go into the game to receive the most patriotic Steam cards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34987081/c089c1375cde5dc2299ece4fcfab85133cf9cf9a.jpg[/img]
